display_information.name: Overtime Approver
display_information.description: Flags employees past 40 hours and asks a manager to approve or deny overtime.
display_information.long_description:
I check ADP hours and post an approval card in #managers when someone passes 40 hours.

Flags employees past 40 hours and asks a manager to approve or deny overtime.

This agent was built on PawsOps and deployed to Slack as its own app for Paws & Stay, a dog boarding business with three locations. All data in this demo is sample data.
